design_description: A high-energy monochrome concept built on the Fracture template, combining aggressive zebra-like striping with shattered geometric overlays. The design uses torn vertical white streaks over a black base, creating a chaotic ripped-surface effect that feels raw, urban, and confrontational. Beneath the stripes, fractured polygon textures and splatter details add another layer of depth, giving the jersey a distressed industrial aesthetic. The black, white, and charcoal palette keeps the kit sharp and intimidating, while the gold logos and crest accents introduce a premium contrast that elevates the overall look. Overall, the design feels like a fusion of streetwear camouflage, fractured marble textures, and animal-instinct aggression — broken geometry, layered destruction, and controlled visual chaos.
